replication_qualification: Packet windows are nested observations within runs and are not independent experimental replicates.
scope_qualification: Perfect pooled detection applies only to the predefined controlled-lab benign HTTP and controlled high-rate HTTP conditions represented by the nine Exp011 runs.
single_class_qualification: Per-run and within-condition balanced accuracy is undefined because each such grouping contains one true class. Fixed-label binary macro-F1 is 0.5 for those single-class groupings and must not be interpreted as 50 percent classification accuracy.
timing_qualification: Timing quantities follow the frozen timestamp formulas and are not end-to-end request latency or total attack-detection latency.
